ruled_out_vectors.vector: C1: FullMath.mulDiv phantom overflow — result * denominator does not equal floor(a*b/d) * denominator
ruled_out_vectors.why_rejected: Forge edge cases (max*max/max, phantom overflow 2^128, zero inputs, denom=0 revert) all pass. Halmos check_mulDivNoPhantomOverflow timed out due to 512-bit arithmetic complexity but explored 17 paths with no violations. Standard Uniswap V3 math, well-audited.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C2: mulDivRoundingUp < mulDiv for some inputs — rounding invariant violation
ruled_out_vectors.why_rejected: Forge fuzz (uint128 inputs, 25 runs) confirms up >= down and diff <= 1. Halmos check_roundingUpAlwaysGtOrEq PASSED symbolically (13 paths). No violation possible.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C3: FixedHelper._splitAmountsAndFeesByHeight — 1-wei swap bypasses fee or creates free tokens
ruled_out_vectors.why_rejected: 1-wei input correctly reverts with FixedPool__ZeroValueSwap (fee rounds to zero, guard rejects). 1000-wei minimum viable. Large inputs capped by reserves. Fixed pool solvency maintained across 100 swaps.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C4: FixedHelper._calculateSwapByInputFixed — max fee (9999 BPS) bypass or zero-liquidity exploit
ruled_out_vectors.why_rejected: 99.99% fee pool correctly processes swap — almost all input goes to fee, output << input. No value creation. Pool with liquidity at max fee is not exploitable.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C5: FixedHelper._calculateSwapByOutputFixed — output = full reserve drains pool beyond reserves
ruled_out_vectors.why_rejected: Swap output = full reserve correctly bounded — amountOut <= reserveWeth. Pool reserves remain non-negative after full-reserve output swap.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C6: FixedHelper._addLiquidity + _removeLiquidity round-trip creates tokens
ruled_out_vectors.why_rejected: Add then withdrawAll round-trip: user gets back <= deposited + 2 wei. Rounding favors protocol. No token creation from add/remove cycle.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C9: DynamicHelper._updatePosition — 0 liquidity change corrupts fee accounting
ruled_out_vectors.why_rejected: 0 liquidity change after 10 swaps processes without error. Fee collection works correctly with 0 delta. No state corruption observed.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C10: DynamicHelper._crossTick — liquidityNet applied incorrectly at tick boundary crossing
ruled_out_vectors.why_rejected: Tick crossing tested in both directions (zeroForOne and oneForZero). Tick decreases for zeroForOne, increases for oneForZero. Tick-price consistency (getTickAtSqrtPrice(sqrtPrice) == tick) holds after crossing in both directions.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C15: BitMath.mostSignificantBit/leastSignificantBit returns incorrect bit index
ruled_out_vectors.why_rejected: Forge: MSB(0) reverts, MSB(1)=0, MSB(max)=255, MSB(2^n)=n for all n 0-254. LSB(0) reverts, LSB(2^n)=n for all n. Halmos: check_msbOfPowerOf2 and check_lsbOfPowerOf2 both PASSED symbolically.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C16: LiquidityMath.addDelta underflow not caught — subtraction wraps silently
ruled_out_vectors.why_rejected: Forge: addDelta(50,-51) reverts, addDelta(max,1) reverts, addDelta(0,int128.min) reverts. Exact zero subtraction works. Halmos: check_noUnderflow PASSED symbolically — all underflow cases revert correctly.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C18: CLOBHelper.calculateFixedInput mulDivRoundingUp overpays maker (taker gets extra tokens)
ruled_out_vectors.why_rejected: CONFIRMED: CLOB uses mulDivRoundingUp (rounds UP output), while SingleProvider uses mulDiv (rounds DOWN). Overpay is O(price_ratio) wei per fill — at price ratio 1038x, overpay=1040 wei for 10 input. At realistic ETH/USDC (~2000 ratio), ~45 wei/fill, ~4500 wei across 100 fills. Economically negligible. Previously noted by math-deep-diver. Not exploitable for profit.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C20: SingleProviderHelper calculateFixedInput/calculateFixedOutput round-trip creates tokens
ruled_out_vectors.why_rejected: Forge fuzz: input->output->input always loses (25 runs both directions). Price=1 exact. Max price bounded. calculateFixedOutput uses mulDivRoundingUp (rounds UP required input), calculateFixedInput uses mulDiv (rounds DOWN output). Correct directions ensure protocol always benefits.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C21: FixedPoolType math invariant violation under Medusa fuzz (round-trip profit, fee exceeds input, rounding inconsistency)
ruled_out_vectors.why_rejected: Medusa: 3/3 property tests passed across 566,701 calls. No round-trip profit, fee never exceeds input, roundingDown <= roundingUp for all inputs explored.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C22: DynamicPoolType math invariant violation under Medusa fuzz (amount delta rounding, addDelta overflow, MSB bounds)
ruled_out_vectors.why_rejected: Medusa: 4/4 property tests passed across 517,149 calls. Rounding directions correct for both amount0 and amount1 deltas, addDelta positive increases always hold, MSB always bounded and correct.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C25: INV-E01 feeGrowthGlobal non-monotonic after swaps — fee leakage
ruled_out_vectors.why_rejected: 100 swaps (50 each direction) on standard pool: feeGrowthGlobal0X128 and feeGrowthGlobal1X128 are monotonically non-decreasing throughout. No fee leakage or accounting reset.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C7 (extended): DynamicHelper.computeSwap tick-price inconsistency at exact tick boundary
ruled_out_vectors.why_rejected: Already covered by parent (C7 test exists). Extended with C10 directional crossing tests. Tick-price consistency holds after all boundary crossings.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C11 (extended): SqrtPriceMath getNextSqrtPrice boundary — zero/max amount, min/max sqrtPrice
ruled_out_vectors.why_rejected: Already covered by parent (C11 tests exist). Zero amount returns same price. Max amount pushes price toward boundary without overflow. Max output reverts correctly.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Fixed pool solvency degradation after many bidirectional swaps
ruled_out_vectors.why_rejected: 50 bidirectional swaps with varying amounts. AMM balances remain positive. Pool remains solvent throughout.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Fixed pool rounding direction inconsistency in calculateFixedSwapByRatio
ruled_out_vectors.why_rejected: 100 sequential checks + fuzz: roundingUp >= roundingDown, diff <= 1 for all inputs. Rounding direction consistent.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C23/C24 extended to Fixed pool: round-trip profit or dust-loop extraction on fixed pool type
ruled_out_vectors.why_rejected: Fuzz: no round-trip profit (25 runs, amounts 1000-50000 USDC). Dust loop (100x 100-wei swaps then reverse) not profitable. 1-wei swaps correctly revert with ZeroValueSwap.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Slither high/medium findings in SingleProviderPoolType scope
ruled_out_vectors.why_rejected: Slither run on lbamm-pool-type-single-provider: 35 total findings, all known patterns — delegateCall return (intentional diamond proxy), uninitialized struct locals (default zero), arbitrary-send-erc20 (expected in AMM), reentrancy-balance (wrappedNative deposit pattern). No novel math-related findings.
